title: GM says it plans to debut OnStar AI, an in-car assistant that can execute vehicle functions and run diagnostics via voice commands, in the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq (Aarian Marshall/Wired)
summary: Aarian Marshall / Wired: GM says it plans to debut OnStar AI, an in-car assistant that can execute vehicle functions and run diagnostics via voice commands, in the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq — The Detroit automaker wants your next vehicle to be a personal assistant, a best friend, and an autonomous errand-runner.
